headline: Public hearings on projects at 240 Lothrop Street, 12 Greenwood Avenue, and 385 & 407 Hale Street.
summary: Public hearings cover a deck and accessory dwelling unit at 240 Lothrop Street and requests to amend orders at 12 Greenwood Avenue and 385 & 407 Hale Street. The agenda also lists determination requests, certificates, extensions, tree removals, and enforcement matters.

xih or go to meet.google.com and enter the 10-digit code 'sbk-brkt-xjh'
ii. For mobile devices (tablets and iPhones/smartphones):
1. Please go to either 'Google Play' [Android] or the IoS 'App Store' [iPhones and iPads]
and download the free program 'Google Meet.'
2. Allow the program to access your device's camera and microphone.
3. Then click 'Enter a meeting code' and type in 'sbk-brkt-xjh'. Then click 'Ask to join.' A
facilitator will enable you to enter the meeting.
b. Telephone: For standard telephones and cell phones:
i. Dial the number: 1 515-207-3273
ii. When prompted, enter the PIN: 261 481 192#
iii. A facilitator will enable you to enter the meeting.
2. Applicants and/or representatives required to appear before the Conservation Commission must make
arrangements to present remotely as there is no physical meeting location. Documentary exhibits and/or
visual presentations must be submitted by Noon on the Friday before the meeting to
conservation@beverlyma.gov, so that they may be displayed for remote public access viewing. Public
comments, if any, are encouraged to be submitted in advance of the meeting.
3. This meeting will not be live broadcast by BevCam.
